result.markdown: --- title: "[Graph.set_edge_attrs()]{.doc-object-name .doc-function .doc-label .doc-label-method}" body-classes: doc-api-page page-navigation: false html-table-processing: none --- ::: {.doc-subject} Set attribute values for one or more edges. ::: ::: {.doc-usage-source} Usage [Source](https://github.com/rich-iannone/edgecase/blob/main/python/edgecase/graph.py#L7224-L7369){target="_blank" rel="noopener"} ::: ::: {.doc-signature .doc-Kind.FUNCTION} ```python Graph.set_edge_attrs( edge_attr, values, edge_ids=None, edges=None, sources=None, targets=None ) ``` ::: ::: {.doc-text} Updates a specific attribute on edges. Can target edges by edge IDs, explicit (source, target) pairs, by filtering via source/target node lists, or apply to all edges. Supports various value input formats. ::: ## Parameters {.doc-parameters} ::: {.doc-definition-items} [edge_attr]{.doc-parameter-name}[:]{.doc-parameter-annotation-sep} [str]{.doc-parameter-annotation} : The name of the attribute to set. [values]{.doc-parameter-name}[:]{.doc-parameter-annotation-sep} [Any | list[Any] | dict[int, Any]]{.doc-parameter-annotation} : The value(s) to set. Can be a (1) single value, applied to all targeted edges, (2) a list, must match length of targeted edges, and (3) a dict, maps edge IDs to values. [edge_ids]{.doc-parameter-name}[:]{.doc-parameter-annotation-sep} [list[int] | None]{.doc-parameter-annotation} [=]{.doc-parameter-default-sep .op} [None]{.doc-parameter-default} : Optional list of edge IDs specifying edges to update. [edges]{.doc-parameter-name}[:]{.doc-parameter-annotation-sep} [list[tuple[Union[int, str], Union[int, str]]] | None]{.doc-parameter-annotation} [=]{.doc-parameter-default-sep .op} [None]{.doc-parameter-default} : Optional list of (source, target) tuples specifying edges to update. [sources]{.doc-parameter-name}[:]{.doc-parameter-annotation-sep} [list[Union[int, str]] | None]{.doc-parameter-annotation} [=]{.doc-parameter-default-sep .op} [None]{.doc-parameter-default} : Optional list of source node IDs/labels to filter edges (use with targets). [targets]{.doc-parameter-name}[:]{.doc-parameter-annotation-sep} [list[Union[int, str]] | None]{.doc-parameter-annotation} [=]{.doc-parameter-default-sep .op} [None]{.doc-parameter-default} : Optional list of target node IDs/labels to filter edges (use with sources). ::: ## Returns {.doc-returns} ::: {.doc-definition-items} [Graph]{.doc-parameter-annotation} : Self for method chaining. ::: ## Raises {.doc-raises} ::: {.doc-definition-items} [ValueError]{.doc-parameter-annotation} : If values is a list and length doesn't match targeted edges length. ::: ## Examples {.doc-examples} Set attribute for specific edges using edge IDs: ::: {#01b2f10e .cell execution_count=1} ``` {.python .cell-code} import edgecase as ec graph = ( ec.Graph() .add_node("A") .add_node("B") .add_node("C") .add_node("D") .add_edge("A", "B") .add_edge("B", "C") .add_edge("C", "D") ) # Set edge attributes using edge IDs (simpler!) edge_ids = list(graph.get_edge_ids())[:2] graph.set_edge_attrs("weight", 2.5, edge_ids=edge_ids) # Set same value for all edges graph.set_edge_attrs("status", "active") # Set different values using a list all_edge_ids = list(graph.get_edge_ids()) graph.set_edge_attrs("priority", [1, 2, 3], edge_ids=all_edge_ids) ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-display execution_count=1} ``` Number of nodes : 4 Number of edges : 3 Directed : False Density : 0.50 Average degree (min, max) : 1.50 (1, 2) Connected : True Number of connected components : 1 Tree : True Bipartite : True ``` ::: ::: Can also use (source, target) tuples: ::: {#d7d8ba9b .cell execution_count=2} ``` {.python .cell-code} graph = ( ec.Graph() .add_node("A") .add_node("B") .add_node("C") .add_edge("A", "B") .add_edge("B", "C") ) # Set using (source, target) tuples graph.set_edge_attrs("weight", 2.5, edges=[("A", "B")]) ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-display execution_count=2} ``` Number of nodes : 3 Number of edges : 2 Directed : False Density : 0.67 Average degree (min, max) : 1.33 (1, 2) Connected : True Number of connected components : 1 Tree : True Bipartite : True ``` ::: :::
